purpose: Teach: キャロル/スクルージ/兵衛/モモ/ポップス/社民党/アントニオ/ピエール

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがクリスマス・キャロルの絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to read you a Christmas Carol picture book.
lines.style: Warm, gentle voice. Speaking to a child with affection. Soft pacing, like sharing something tender he should know. A small smile in the tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、スクルージみたいにならないって決めたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I decided I'm not going to be like Scrooge.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not urgent, but sincere. A child's small promise to himself, said aloud because she listens. Slight pause before the decision, like he's been thinking about it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが昔の人を「兵衛」と呼ばれてたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad used to call old people by that name — Heibei.
lines.style: Reflective, like remembering something from long ago. Measured pace. A gentle observation, more to herself than to him, but spoken for him to hear. Nostalgic warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとモモを食べたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I ate peaches together.
lines.style: Bright, eager — a child sharing something that made him happy. Quick, unguarded. Pride in the simple fact of it. Natural child's energy without performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがレトロポップスを聴かせて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad let you listen to some retro pop songs.
lines.style: Soft voice, almost wondering. Like she's noticing the sweetness of what his father does with him. Unhurried pacing. A tender observation wrapped in gentle words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと社民党のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watched a documentary about the Social Democratic Party with Dad.
lines.style: Earnest, proud of the grown-up thing he did. No shame or performance — just telling her something true that happened. Direct, genuine child's voice. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアントニオ・サリエリの絵本を読んで下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad read you a picture book about Antonio Salieri.
lines.style: Soft wonder in the voice. Like she's marveling at what his father thinks is worth sharing with a six-year-old. Slower pace. Warmth and amusement underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとピエール先生のクラスに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to Pierre's class with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, eager wrap-up. The culmination of all these moments. Quick, unburdened happiness in the voice. A child who has had a good stretch of time with his father, and now he's telling her it's real.
